# PDF compressor

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pdf-compressor/

Try a structure-only PDF rewrite, or reduce scanned-page size by making a new image-based PDF at a chosen quality and resolution.

## How to use it

1. Choose the PDF documents or images from your device.
2. Arrange files or enter the pages and layout options.
3. Create the document and download the finished PDF.

## Example

Try a 120-DPI JPEG copy of a photo-heavy scan and compare its byte size with the original.

## Limits and checks

Image-based compression can remove selectable text, links, forms and annotations. Files may not shrink; the tool reports the actual change and preserves your original.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
